excerpts: AZ IDs are unique and consistent identifiers for Availability Zones across accounts.

For the listed Regions including N. Virginia and Oregon, accounts created before November 2025 independently map Availability Zones to codes; accounts created starting November 2025 get the same Availability Zones mapped to codes. All other Regions use a uniform mapping.
Availability Zones always have optInStatus opt-in-not-required. Local Zones and Wavelength Zones can be opted-in or not-opted-in.
parentZoneId and parentZoneName identify the zone handling some Local/Wavelength Zone control plane operations.
LookupEvents looks up regional management/Insights events from the last 90 days. Maximum 50 events per page; use NextToken with the same parameters. Two requests per second per account per Region.
Amazon ECS logs all control plane operations as management events. Event history does not record data events.
CloudTrail log files are not an ordered stack trace; events do not appear in any specific order.
